name: The Perceptual Contrast Principle
scenario: Pitching ongoing professional services retained tiers to a mid-market manufacturing enterprise.
script: "Our fully dedicated, 24/7 on-site systems engineering transformation team requires an annual capital allocation of $1,400,000. However, our tailored advisory architecture, which embeds our staff for critical sprint reviews, sits at $340,000."
defense: Isolate the target: the $1.4M configuration is irrelevant here; judge the $340,000 proposal on its own economics.
originFull: Perceptual Contrast and Adaptation-Level Theory show that human evaluation is comparative rather than absolute; evaluating an extreme proposition first makes a subsequent moderate proposition appear substantially more reasonable.
defenseFull: Neutralize the contrast anchor by isolating the target option: "The $1.4M configuration is wholly irrelevant to our operating scale. We will evaluate the $340,000 proposal strictly on its standalone unit economics and market comparables."
